shared_elements: standing human figures in strict profile
bearded male figures with elaborately curled hair/beard
long fringed or pleated robes reaching the ankles
figures carrying/holding objects in extended hands
low relief carving on flat stone panels
registers separated by horizontal dividing lines
detailed patterned rendering of hair, beard and garment fringes
justification: Both show bearded male figures in strict profile with elaborately curled hair and beards, long fringed robes and objects held in outstretched hands, rendered in low relief within horizontally divided registers, a set of conventions specific enough to suggest a shared tradition. The biggest difference in content is that B centres on a single large winged figure holding a bucket and cone (a supernatural attribute absent in A), while A depicts multiple small-scale wingless figures in a long procession with chariots and horses above.
